{{External|rs}} {{otheruses|the Woodcutting tree|other uses|Teak (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Normal |version2 = Prifddinas |version3 = Isle of Souls |name = Teak tree |image1 = [[File:Teak tree.png|x300px]] |image2 = [[File:Teak tree (Prifddinas).png|x300px]] |image3 = [[File:Teak tree (Isle of Souls).png|x300px]] |release1 = [[9 August]] [[2005]] |release2 = [[25 July]] [[2019]] |release3 = [[3 February]] [[2021]] |update1 = Tai Bwo Wannai Clean-Up |update2 = Song of the Elves |update3 = The Isle of Souls |members = Yes |quest = No |location = Varies |options = Chop down |examine = A beautiful old teak tree. |map = No |dropversion1 = |dropversion2 = Prifddinas |dropversion3 = |id1 = 9036 |id2 = 36686 |id3 = 40758 |leagueRegion1 = Kandarin,Fremennik,Karamja,Desert,Morytania,Misthalin,Desert,Varlamore |leagueRegion2 = Tirannwn |leagueRegion3 = Misthalin }} A '''teak tree''' is a tropical hardwood lumber tree that requires level 35 [[Woodcutting]] to cut, granting 85 Woodcutting [[experience]] for each set of [[teak logs]] received. Teak trees provide some of the highest Woodcutting experience per hour, so it is common to find multiple players attempting to cut teak trees. The [[Isle of Souls]] is a popular location for cutting teak trees in [[Forestry]] worlds with no requirements. However, east of [[Locus Oasis]] in [[Varlamore]] can provide an alternative low-requirement location, being both closer to a [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] ({{fairycode|AJP}}) and the [[Quetzal Transport System]], in addition to the passive chance of receiving a [[Loop half of key (moon key)]]. ==Tree locations== {{ObjectTableHead}} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Teak tree |location = [[Chompy Marsh]] |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |2335,3048 |mtype=pin |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Teak tree |location = [[Etceteria]] (no logs)Teak trees can only be chopped in [[Etceteria]] with [[Queen Sigrid]]'s approval upon completion of [[Royal Trouble]], [[Managing Miscellania#Approval rating|Miscellania approval rating]] less than 100%, and '''does not''' reward logs. |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |2593,3893|2595,3893|2595,3895|2602,3896|2603,3897|2605,3896|2605,3898|2608,3899|2594,3890 |mtype=pin |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Teak tree |location = [[Ape Atoll]] |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |2773,2698|2773,2700|2776,2698 |mtype=pin |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Teak tree |location = [[Kharazi Jungle]]Players must partially complete [[Legends' Quest]] and get directions to the jungle first. |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |2835,2905|2837,2907|2837,2911|2896,2897|2899,2901 |mtype=pin |leagueRegion = Karamja }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Teak tree |location = [[Hardwood Grove]]Players must pay 100 [[trading sticks]] to [[Murcaily]] in order to enter. ===Notable locations=== * [[Prifddinas]] - Popular location for a [[Tick manipulation#2-tick Woodcutting|2-tick tick manipulation]] training method due to the nearby rabbits. Able to receive [[Crystal shard]] drops. * [[Ape Atoll]] - Popular location for a [[Tick manipulation#2-tick Woodcutting|2-tick tick manipulation]] training method due to the nearby birds. * [[Fossil Island]] - The 3 hardwood tree patches here can be used for a [[Tick manipulation#1.5-tick Woodcutting|1.5 tick manipulation]] training method. * [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] - Requires 100 [[Trading sticks]] to enter. The nearby Tai Bwo Wannai Parcel Service can transport logs to your bank for 10 trading sticks each. * [[Locus Oasis]] - Close proximity to a [[Quetzal Transport System]] landing site [[Outer Fortis]] which can be taken to [[Auburnvale]] to bank quickly. Able to receive [[Ent seed]] and [[Loop half of key (moon key)]] drops. ==Woodcutting info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Teak tree |level = 35 |xp = 85 |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 9 seconds |dropversion = Prifddinas }} {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Teak logs|quantity=1|rarity=Always|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Conditional drops=== The following table shows items that can be received in addition to the main resource. {{DropLogProject|kills=162522}} {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Beaver|quantity=1|rarity=Very rare|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=Scales from 1 in 263,461 chance at level 35 to 1 in 261,861 chance at level 99.}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Loop half of key (moon key)|quantity=1|rarity=1/1762|raritynotes=Only in [[Varlamore]].|skill=Woodcutting|leagueRegion=Varlamore}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Ent seed|quantity=1|rarity=1/400|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=|image=Ent seed 3.png|leagueRegion=Varlamore}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Clue nest|quantity=1|rarity=Rare|skill=Woodcutting|image=Clue nest (beginner).png|raritynotes=[[Twitcher's gloves]] can increase the chance of spawning by 20%. Wearing a [[Ring of wealth (i)]] doubles the drop chance from trees in the Wilderness.|namenotes=Clue nests will drop as [[Bird nest (empty)]] and [[scroll boxes]] after the completion of [[X Marks the Spot]]}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Crystal shard|quantity=1|rarity=1/40|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=Only in [[Prifddinas]].|image=Crystal shard 5.png|dropversion=Prifddinas|leagueRegion=Tirannwn}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Medallion fragment#6|alt=Medallion fragment|image=Medallion fragment (6).png|quantity=1|rarity=Always|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=Only at [[Shimmering Atoll]] if the player does not have the fragment or the medallion of the deep already.}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===[[Bird nest]]s=== Bird nests have a 1/256(1/230 with the [[Woodcutting cape]]) chance to be received instead of a log. They will be placed on the ground and despawn after 2 minutes.{{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Bird nest (egg)|quantity=1|rarity=Very Rare|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=|image=Bird nest (blue egg).png}}{{DropsLineSkill|name=Bird nest (seeds)|quantity=1|rarity=Rare|skill=Woodcutting|raritynotes=[[Twitcher's gloves]] allow the wearer to make a specific type of nest 20% more likely to appear.The [[Strung rabbit foot]] makes seed nests slightly less likely to appear, increasing the chances of receiving a ring or egg nest.}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Bird nest (ring)|quantity=1|rarity=Rare|raritynotes=|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Mechanics== A teak tree will fall after 50 [[ticks]] (30 seconds) of chopping; the depletion timer regenerates if players stop cutting the tree before it is fully chopped. Once felled, it will take 15 ticks (9 seconds) to respawn. A roll to receive a log is done every 4 game [[ticks]] when chopping. The chance to successfully chop is affected by the [[axe]] used and Woodcutting level: better axes and a higher woodcutting level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving a log. ===Cut chance=== The following chart indicates the success rate of chopping teak with different types of axes.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1448361716061032456|date=13 October 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99055|archivedate=15 September 2022}} {{Skilling success chart|label=Teak tree cut chance|xlabel=Woodcutting level|showbefore=no |label1=Bronze|low1=15|high1=46|req1=35|color1=saddlebrown|image1=Bronze axe.png |label2=Iron|low2=23|high2=70|req2=35|color2=dimgray|image2=Iron axe.png |label3=Steel|low3=31|high3=93|req3=35|color3=lightgray|image3=Steel axe.png |label4=Black|low4=35|high4=102|req4=35|color4=black|image4=Black axe.png |label5=Mithril|low5=39|high5=117|req5=35|color5=slateblue|image5=Mithril axe.png |label6=Adamant|low6=47|high6=140|req6=35|color6=seagreen|image6=Adamant axe.png |label7=Rune|low7=55|high7=164|req7=41|color7=steelblue|image7=Rune axe.png |label8=Dragon|low8=60|high8=190|req8=61|color8=firebrick|image8=Dragon axe.png |label9=Crystal|low9=60|high9=200|req9=71|color9=cyan|image9=Crystal axe.png }} ==Farming== {{Main|Teak seed}} With level 35 Farming, [[teak seed]]s may be grown into a Teak tree, which gives [[teak logs]] when cut down. Checking on a fully grown and healthy teak tree will give 7,290 Farming experience. It takes 74.6 hours to grow. When cut down, the tree will automatically regrow after a period of time. A player may also pay 15 [[limpwurt roots]] (can be noted) to a nearby [[Squirrel (Fossil Island)|squirrel]] to guarantee its growth. ==Lore== There are several mentions of teak trees by NPCs around [[Gielinor]] as well as in books. The following text is transcluded from [[Gielinor's flora - trees]]. The information found within the book is more often than not just flavour text, and does not reflect their properties or uses within the game itself.
A tropical hardwood tree species that naturally occurs among other jungle trees. Coveted for its durability and water resistance, it is mainly used boat building, exterior construction, furniture and carving. Another prized feature of teak wood is its resistance to termite damage. A final interesting fact is that teak trees are more closely related to mint than to any other trees in Gielinor.
